title: Enlarge the finite-type locus of a global module by one affine open
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $W\subseteq X$ be a quasi-compact open [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], and let $V\subseteq X$ be an affine open. Let $\mathcal H$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent] such that $\mathcal H|_W$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Then there exists a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal E$ with a monomorphism $j:\mathcal E\to\mathcal H$ such that $\mathcal E|_{W\cup V}$ is of finite type and $j|_W$ is an isomorphism. No quasi-compactness of $X$ or finite type of $\mathcal E$ outside $W\cup V$ is required.

proof.text: Apply the affine-union construction to obtain G on U = W union V, its monomorphism phi into H restricted to U, and its isomorphism on W. This is precisely the local affine and gluing part of the original route.

U is compact as the union of the compact W and affine V. Its open immersion into quasi-separated X is quasi-compact. Extend G and phi to a quasi-coherent K, a map psi into H, and an isomorphism alpha from K restricted to U to G.

Set E to the abelian image of psi and j to its inclusion. The cokernel is quasi-coherent by the proved source cokernel theorem, and E, its kernel, is quasi-coherent by the proved source kernel theorem. Restriction of psi to U is alpha.hom followed by monic phi. Its factor through E is therefore monic, and is epic since open restriction preserves epimorphisms; hence it is an isomorphism. Compose its inverse with alpha to identify E restricted to U with G. Transport the local finite generators of G through this isomorphism to prove finite type on U.

Use the natural isomorphism overFunctorMap for W contained in U. It conjugates restriction to W with the further restriction overMap from U to W. Thus psi and its image factor are isomorphisms on W. From their factorization, j restricted to W is the inverse of the restricted image factor followed by the restricted psi, so is an isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: S3 formalization of 01PF affine-union construction followed by 01PE(3), abelian image factorization, and overFunctorMap; uses proved source kernel/cokernel closure instead of affine image sections.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteType_affine_enlargement
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X)) (V : X.affineOpens)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [H.IsQuasicoherent]
    [(H.over W).IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ (E : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)), E.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      (E.over (W ⊔ V.1)).IsFiniteType ∧ ∃ (j : E ⟶ H),
        Mono j ∧ IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) W).map j)
